build_eagle_mistral_draft_model: build a Mistral draft model for speculative decoding using EagleMistralModel with vllm_config
create_eagle_decoder_layer: create an EagleMistralDecoderLayer that uses draft model quantization config from vllm_config
run_eagle_mistral_forward: run the EagleMistralModel forward pass with input_ids, positions, and hidden_states tensors
load_eagle_mistral_weights: load weights into EagleMistralModel while sharing embed_tokens from the target model
